physical.title: album; painting; papercut
physical.summary:
Portrait of a foot-soldier of the old corps of armourers attached to the Janissaries; painting mounted onto an  album  folio,  B side. Shown wearing a helmet with a stiff white aigrette in the plume-holder. Green tunic, white leg-protectors, brown shoes. Wearing a sword and dagger and carrying a matchlock. A cloth is wrapped around his head under the helmet, covering his ears and chin. Stylised pink lilac cut-outs on either side. Inscribed. Album contains sixty folios   with fifty-nine paintings of figures, and additional découpages, including floral and vegetal decoration in some  margins.

Ink and opaque watercolour, with découpage on paper. Album covered with green leather.
